context:
# Goal
Souji round 23, WAVE 2 (falsify). The round's work is landed at lane commits 4765250 and c0eeaa7.
Three claims, frozen in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-23/preregistration.txt: C1 record agreement
(calibration), C2 blob-bound receipts (operability), C3 F2 read side (coverage). Your job is to
attack ONE landed artifact against the bytes at the current lane tip and say whether it survives.

# HARD BOUND
souji writes only inside /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin. Never delete, move, quarantine or classify-for-cleanup anything in
/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin outside that path. Never touch .scratch/, .ufo/state/, MANIFEST.json,
the fleet scripts/ or templates/, sibling lanes, or the lane's jj state / git index.

# Contract
- READ-ONLY. Run read-only commands; write ONLY your own report. No git/jj mutation, no rm/mv, no
  signals, no installs (pacman is paused host-wide). Scratch only under /var/tmp/souji-r23-w2-<Name>/
  and removed before you finish.
- Absolute paths; your tools start at the FLEET root. Every `Report:` trailer is relative to
  /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/<that path>.
- Attack means: re-run the claim's own counting command, or open the artifact and test it. Quote
  the command and its output. `[INFERENCE]` for anything you did not run.
- A finding must name the file and line and say what the round must do (fix / disclose / accept).
  "Looks fine" is not a verdict; give `survives` or `falsified` with evidence.
- Certification OFF, K5 HELD. No credentials, no live /proc, no operator-sweep contents.
